quotes.name: Rose Delgado
quotes.quote: The Fruitvale community review is set for the first Thursday of next month at the Fruitvale Senior Center, 6 p.m., with the design team in the room — and yes, the held design covers the site work, because we're not letting construction outrun the community's say.
